1. Read order dated February 27, 2026.

It appears that the said order was communicated by learned Registrar (Judicial Service), Calcutta High Court, to the Member Secretary of the State Legal Services Authority, West Bengal, on March 2, 2026.

sentences.text: We do not find on record the report that we had called for from the District Legal Services Authority, Hooghly.

2. List this matter once again on March 12, 2026.
3.
In the mean time, we request learned Registrar (Judicial Service), to look into the matter.
In re : CRAN 2 of 2025 4.

The petitioner was convicted under Section 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act and sentenced to suffer imprisonment for life.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 5. He now prays for suspension of sentence.
He says that he is in custody for about four years and six months.
6. Learned State counsel and learned advocate for the victim/de facto complainant strongly oppose the prayer.
They say that the victim became pregnant as a result of being ravished by the petitioner.
She also gave birth to a child.
DNA test confirms that the petitioner is the father of the child.

sentences.text: Therefore, no leniency should be shown to the petitioner.
7. We have gone through the material-on-record.
Prima facie, we find very strong incriminating evidence against the petitioner.
The DNA report alone is sufficient, at this stage, for us to reject the petitioner's prayer.
The petitioner is also a married person.
8. Learned advocate for the petitioner says that the physical relationship between his client and the victim girl was consensual.
There was no forced rape.
The consent of a minor girl is of no consequence and ineffective in law.
9. CRAN 2 of 2025 is dismissed.
In Re : CRA (DB) 12 of 2025 10.
From a departmental note dated January 22, 2026, we see that the department has called for the Trial Court Records vide Memo dated January 22, 2026.
The department is yet to receive the records.
11. The department is directed to expedite the preparation of paper book so that the paper book is ready by the end of April, 2026.

12. Place the matter in the combined Monthly List of May 2026, amongst the first ten items.
(Apurba Sinha Ray, J.) (Arijit Banerjee, J.)
